name: Pureprime -pianissimo-
source:
One day main character suddenly has to live with his three sisters. Every day is full of laughter now. And every night sisters visit his room and talk about lots of different things...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
某一天，主人公突然开始与三位姐妹同住。如今，每天都充满欢笑。每到夜晚，姐妹们便会来到他的房间，聊起各种各样的事情…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
